name: thumbnail-slider

frames.best_why: Frame 1 shows a fully loaded landscape slide with the thumbnail strip beneath and the first thumb highlighted.
frames.render_note: Frames 2-5 show large blank areas where slide photos have not loaded.

tagline: A large photo above a dimmed strip of thumbnails, one lit.
summary: A photo viewer with one large rounded frame on top and a row of small previews beneath. Picking a thumbnail swaps the main picture and lights that thumbnail.
appearance: A wide rounded photo slide above a row of seven small square thumbnails; the current thumbnail has a light border and the others are dimmed. The loaded main image is a lake scene with rocks and autumn trees.
behaviour: Clicking a thumbnail jumps the large photo to that slide and moves the highlight; the strips stay in sync as they slide.
demo_content: A lake with autumn trees, a misty pond, flowers and a cherry blossom branch
search_phrases: click small pictures to change the big one
choose a picture from small previews
use_when: A gallery has several photos and users want to jump to one quickly.
avoid_when: Seven remote photos load at once, so blank slides appear on a slow connection.
customise: Seven image URLs are hardcoded; slide height and thumbnail size are classes in the file.
weight_why: Seven full-size photos plus thumbnails load together; scrolling is light.

a11y.note: Thumbnails are clickable divs, not buttons, and every main photo's alt text is just "image".

issues: Every main image uses the alt text "image".
Several frames show slide areas half blank while photos load.
polish_why: Tidy viewer with a clear active thumbnail; blank-loading slides and generic alts detract.
title: Thumbnail Slider
